    Profile

    Eins is the leader of the Veda Templars. He longed to save Lost Blue, and the path he chose led to him being a leader. He has an eccentric personality, by enjoying free time by doing nothing, but that is part of his charm. Though his subpar ability to give nicknames is less than ideal.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Male
    Height: 187cm
    Weight: 72kg
    Birthday: Sept 12
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Philosophy
    Hobbies: Doing nothing in his free time
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 鈴村健一
